clarity.notes: Two-screen flow: join -> canvas. Canvas chrome is one pill bar; every tool lives in the radial menu, hint line explains it once.

hierarchy.notes: Eye lands on the Component.tsx card first; topbar reads brand -> room -> presence -> live -> share in one scan.

typography.notes: Mono reserved for code, room code, badges and metadata; system sans for UI; single consistent 11-14px scale.

motion.notes: Spring pop on radial buttons (staggered), eased peer-cursor drift, conic-gradient analyzing state, pop-in sticky. One flourish budget respected.

brand.notes: Brief tokens bound verbatim: #09090b canvas, faint dot grid, glassmorphism, cyan single primary accent, emerald reserved for live/multiplayer.
